authored_test_evaluator_filters: Two explicitly recorded pre-existing AnyIO deprecation warnings are ignored by the supplementary authored-test command; the frozen strict/upstream commands remain unchanged.
classification: Root independent manual review of terminal Starlette fast-MCP patch after source-exact evaluator reconstruction
limits: Manual source review and nineteen bounded behavioral checks plus retained upstream selections do not prove every possible ASGI interaction.
Restoring only base production yields two expected missing-feature collection errors in authored tests; this is not an independent mutation sensitivity proof for each case.
reviewed_behaviors: Shared limit validation rejects bool/negative/noninteger before reads, including cached body.
Request.body counts actual received byte chunks, checks before buffering the crossing chunk, and only caches complete accepted body.
Cached body lower bounds raise limit/received exception attributes without destroying cached body/JSON or rereading transport.
Middleware buffers only limited HTTP requests, rejects before application, ignores misleading Content-Length, and replays accepted bytes once before delegating every later receive.
Disconnects and endpoint exceptions preserve their ordinary failure behavior; non-HTTP and unlimited requests bypass buffering.
Added tests cover UTF8 bytes, zero/equal/large bounds, empty/omitted chunks, cached JSON/body, partial disconnect, rejection stopping reads, and endpoint failures.
